full_semantic_decision_read.limitations: Whole proposed difference is immunity masking effective state while actual environment can reacquire stored exposure, followed by deadline unmasking and different real AI eligibility consumers. Generic timed immunity, another debuff name or particle factory alone would0. Manual cleansing is not preventive: clean players and players with hidden smell during immunity receive no600 extension and no consumption, although use return and client bubbles remain success-like. Do not report visual bubbles as server acceptance. Under ordinary world-time arithmetic, water while visibly smelly does not refresh, water while immune refreshes latent smell to at least24000. At immunity expiry the still-positive raw smell becomes effective. No remove/re-add hook fires; this is not a hidden PotionEffect rollover. Smelly-selector continuation omits parent distance/sight/team/creative/target-class checks; no native parent/scheduler source was located in the fixed cache (similarly named Lycanites class is not the Minecraft parent). We do not substitute versions or infer engine reset behavior. Explicit returnfalse is proven, immediate actual target clear is not. Wight custom predicate is only initial suitability; existing pursuit and independent revenge/attack tasks can persist. Immunity is not all-mob target denial, total stealth, damage protection, decay immunity or guaranteed disengagement. Deadline subtraction casts long to int before clamp, raw saved longs unvalidated. Extreme/future/old times or clock shifts can produce overflow/incorrect remaining calculations. No global-world-clock synchronization or dimension rebase claim. Setters lack universal side guard; known water/manual callers are server-guarded, client tick only generates flies. Packet mirrors deadlines, not an authoritative target-denial receipt, and local clock agreement was not tested. TrackingTime20 is readiness threshold checked before increment, not unconditional exact20tick periodic snapshot. With lastUpdate0 and dirty, ordinary update becomes ready on21st call. Deadline expiry alone does not dirty, and retained snapshot can change effective state locally. Invalid external tracker may be removed then still updated this iteration, as coordinator corrected in018. No total no-late-packet guarantee. Initial/missing-target packet handling, nondeath Clone and current-dimension checks are support0. Fly own class lacks player/capability/target identity. It wanders near its initial coordinates and is not tethered to current player, not per-monster denial feedback. Existing flies need not disappear on cure. Parent expiry and textures/audio/visual acceptance unverified. Only native registration bindings, actual methods and selected helper chains cited. Not full Wight/Lurker entities, native vanilla AI parent, decay system, advancement implementation or Censer tile. No game/nativeJava/network/build/asset actions. Migration captured-fish freshness owner remains whole and receives no new credit; that producer is not used as the new core chain. Censer body and all API/serialization/packet/registry/factory wrappers support0. Coordinator independently read all33 cited ranges/2800lines plus native init166..228 extra63lines;34ranges2863lines. Eleven complete earlier semantic decisions and one whole captured-fish migration decision compared; old underlying sourcechains not newly read. Whole masking/reacquisition/derived-qualification lifecycle1. Closest Gloam aftercare zeros exposure during lock; this permits exposure under immunity. Permanent goal edits, current equipment policy, effect re-add/hidden rollover and captured-fish freshness remain their whole previous owners. No helper/particle/timer/registration credits. Wight !smelly still permits non-sneaking target; immunity does not promise Wight refusal, existing pursuit cancellation, revenge suppression, damage protection or decay protection. Smelly continuation lacks the parent sight/distance/team gates; no native scheduler inspection or immediate disengagement claim. Capability raw long reads unvalidated; remaining casts long difference to int before clamp. Dimension clock changes/overflow not repaired or proven synchronized. Death Clone not persistent by inherited !wasDead; ordinary nondeath clone uses serialized deadlines without rebase. Tracker readiness20 becomes ready at21st ordinary update starting0, and sends only if dirty. Expiry alone does not dirty. Invalid tracker can be removed and still updated same iteration. Packet current dimension/intID lacks UUID/sequence/retry. Native transport/client clock convergence unverified. Hand use SUCCESS and six client bubble attempts do not prove cleaning or consumption. Censer body uses raw remaining but actual registration/expense consumer not closed, support0. Fly factory default400 not guaranteed visible duration; renderer/stitch/native parent lifetime unverified. Native init178..193 actually calls registerEventHandlers183, closing the registration call gap in proposal. No upstream/Dynasty game run, assets, production immunity patch, checklist deletion or claimed hours.

TAN clemency forces displayed/current temperature neutral while target/delay fields remain, but no new independent timed mask/reacquisition family is proved and clemency producer is already migration-owned.

full_semantic_decision_read.full_chain_observation: 实际注册EntitySwarm、player-only SwarmedCapability及两个handler。原生近战useStandardAttack返回true才加0.33强度，不测HP差；独立server onUpdate在距离<3.25且canEntityBeSeen时按距离/群大小加权累积，不需要hurt。两入口共享clamp0..1的强度，并覆盖damage属性及weak source。 Swarmed END server PlayerTick先丢弃已死亡来源引用，但保留强度/伤害；hurtTimer正值减1。强度>0时water material或burning置0；否则挥手、向上位移>0.1或潜行任一满足就减0.01，hurtTimer5并实际player.setSneaking(false)。向上外力也能满足，不能称只检测跳跃键。 仍在本次进入的strength>0区块内，wrap当前角度减last得dYaw/dPitch，再wrap它们减上次delta得ddYaw/ddPitch，合成ddRot>30则减(ddRot-30)*0.001；记录角度与delta。匀速转动后续差分为0，不等同持续摇动。开始附身/清零/重载未见历史初始化或reset。 减轻后strength<0.1才每tick再减0.0005并保留旧damageTimer；否则timer+1，严格大于15+(1-strength)*75时先reset0，再请求max(0,min(health-1,storedDamage))伤害。正值时有来源用EntityDamageSource(bl.swarm)，否则generic同key，都bypassArmor；忽略hurt返回。低强度暂停的timer会在新暴露时续走。 strength及hurtTimer改变才markDirty，damage/damageTimer/source setter不标脏；trackingTime0只让dirty快照下次tracker更新可发，不是无条件每tick发。实际join/startTracking初始快照、server END维护、换维度重发及stop/leave移除链均读完。NBT/快照只有strength/hurtTimer/damageTimer/damage；不含weak来源/角度历史；base Clone默认!wasDead。 实际MessageRegistry CLIENT绑定→主线程scheduled process→MessageEntity当前world dimension匹配后用intID查实体→capabilityID查当前能力→readTrackingDataFromNBT。无UUID、epoch、seq、过期或目标缺失重试；只证实际代码路径，不是运行同步通过。 ClientProxy注册ScreenRenderHandler.INSTANCE；unpaused client START调用renderer.update，取current renderView capability，否则采样strength0。仅local hurtTicks==-1且cap.hurtTimer>0才启动10个客户端tick计数，随后递减；这是掙脫分支的cue，不是玩家实际掉血。持续掙脫可在计数归-1后重触发。 实际renderer strength>0.01增crawler并按强度限量，GuiCrawler按hurtTicks旋转/红色tint，70后淡出、80后dead；drop改变运动。Post CROSSHAIRS绘制剩余crawler与按strength插值的overlay。清强度停止新增，不立即清列表。strength>0.05启动SwarmAttackSound，后者追当前view位置并以0.05步长靠近strength*0.5音量；无view/结束条件停止。SafeStreamSound可推迟stream完成200updates。所有资产/声音未运行或制作。
full_semantic_decision_read.concrete_observation: Registered Swarm melee success or independent near-visible aura accumulates player Swarmed strength. Actual server END samples swing/rise/sneak and second angle differences to reduce strength; sneak reset and hurtTimer cue represent counteraction, not HP success. Low strength pauses residual damage clock. Dirty snapshots feed current-view overlay/audio; death of source does not clear retained load.
